rationale: Exact controlled third-party Qwen3-4B base: commercial derivative training only, subject to Apache-2.0 obligations and separate technical and dataset admission; no production release.

findings: Official Qwen/Qwen3-4B pinned source publishes Apache-2.0; three BF16 shard digests, tokenizer digest, configuration and license digest match publisher evidence. Source-to-MLX conversion was executed locally offline with remote code disabled.
A second independent execution on the same Mac/environment reproduced all 9 output file SHA256 digests, including checkpoint 55467c6157306f2a4463e9d149b0ed2552943f187778cc67d02e5bef4735773d.

Ten short prompts produced identical chat-template token IDs between BF16 source and 4-bit conversion; next-token logits had minimum cosine 0.79986734, top-1 agreement 7/10, and maximum softmax total variation 0.919681. Quantized inference equivalence is not demonstrated; task suitability requires further evaluation.
The older Qwen3-4B-MLX-4bit snapshot e56a94b846a2dce7d1cc154ce58b9cfc4b8d99e8ffb74bfe256a265f4cbc7fb9 is a separate unproven conversion and is outside this review.

restrictions: Owner decision, human technical review, and admission checks are still required before training; no decision is inferred from these engineering findings.
Scope is commercial derivative training on this exact third-party base only. This grants no dataset admission, production release, Azaeron-native ownership, or use of the older MLX bundle.
Preserve Qwen attribution and Apache-2.0 obligations. No external AI inference API, public deployment, or production registry promotion is authorized by this packet.
Any future technical review must assess the observed next-token disagreement, Qwen3 thinking-mode handling, and changed EOS stopping behavior before claiming source inference equivalence.
risks: Apache-2.0 imposes preservation of license/copyright/attribution and any applicable NOTICE and marking of modifications. No NOTICE file is published in the pinned source snapshot; downstream notices still require review.

Quantization materially changes measured next-token logits on ten short prompts (softmax total variation as high as 0.919681). Sampled source-to-dequantized weight relative RMSE is 9.45%-10.25%. No source-equivalence acceptance, task-quality benchmark, or production-serving evidence exists for this conversion.
The converted README.md is a minimal generated file; full source card is separately hashed. A trained Azaeron derivative needs its own card and independent evaluation.
